comment: It is very important that the guidance provides general principles and gives national organisations the opportunity to design a national blueprint fit for purpose in their own setting. However, there is no process for incorporating learning from countries back into the guidance.

anchor.note: p.98–99 read as the printed page, no line resolved; in the cited section

public.text: It is very important that the guidance provides general principles and gives national organisations the opportunity to design a national blueprint fit for purpose in their own setting. However, there is no process for incorporating learning from countries back into the guidance.
public.suggestedRevision: Recommend that countries work through a quality circle (Plan, Do, Check, Act), and that WHO then collects the national blueprints and shares lessons learned across countries so each country can build on others' experience.
